items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary, sold when you buy Ricochet later.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-7,200 (levels 1-13). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Jar of Dead T2, Borrowed Decree T2. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Active Reload.

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healbane, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 16 to Grasping Hands's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healbane, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Tesla Bullets
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Active Reload completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Active Reload completes 4.8k weapon in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Active Reload
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 7,200-22,400 (levels 13-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Jar of Dead T3, Essence Theft T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Grasping Hands, damage) grows from 138 to 306. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Healbane, spirit 4.8k at Mystic Vulnerability.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Healbane completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Healbane completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Healbane
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.why: vitality investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 11200 souls (~11.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Imbued on Jar of Dead: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +7 on its damage (0.25x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power.

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Split Shot
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Sell it late for a counter.

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Capacitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Sell Extra Regen for this if you have it.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 32,000-54,400 (levels 30-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Grasping Hands T3, Borrowed Decree T3.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 25,600 to 32,000 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Capacitor? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Split Shot.
sections.desc: Dying after Capacitor? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Split Shot.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you. Pop it and keep shooting.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows, hexes and burns like Infernus's.

items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their damage is big spirit hits.

items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Jar of Dead: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Replaces Surge of Power: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Jar of Dead. Sell Surge of Power for this.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
